newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Trust holders approve merger.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust holders approve merger.

text.p: Bankers Trust New York Corp shareholders by a wide margin Wednesday approved issuance of 25.96 million shares for the planned merger with Alex. Brown Inc.

Of approximately 59 million shares voted, 58.67 million shares or 98.7 million of the shares were voted in favor of the merger. Subject to a final tally, less than one percent were voted against the proposal and less than one percent of the shares were withheld from voting. Bankers Trust has a total of 77.39 million shares outstanding.

Alex. Brown shareholders are scheduled to vote at a meeting later Wednesday in Baltimore on approval of the merger plan, which calls for the exchange of 0.83 share of Bankers Trust for each Alex. Brown share.

During the brief Bankers Trust meeting in New York, chairman and chief exectuive Frank Newman was questioned by a shareholder about a recent report that the company's office building at 280 Park Avenue in New York has been sold. Newman declined comment, referring to the report as rumor and "an unconfirmed report." Bankers Trust owns the building and the land.
Newman said Bankers Trust expects all of the necessary approvals for the completion of the merger by the end of July.

Newman said the shareholder votes represented "a great day for Bankers Trust." He noted that the combination of Alex. Brown's mergers and acquisitions advisory business with Banker's Trust's BT Wolfensohn unit will give the firm a formidable presence in M&A.

Newman declined comment on an analyst's estimate that pooled earnings of Bankers Trust and Alex. Brown will be $7.10 per share in 1997. He told a shareholder the transaction is expected to be accretive to earnings in the second year.
